about: Commit identities that are software, not people, where git itself does not say so. A GitHub App account (login ending in [bot]) is software by GitHub's own rule and needs no entry. Every other identity a pinned commit names, and this file does not list, is a Schema.org Person. Each entry cites the vendor page that declares the identity as its agent.

agents.name: Cursor
agents.why: Cursor's background agent signs its commits with this address as a Co-authored-by trailer (https://docs.cursor.com/background-agent).

agents.name: Claude
agents.why: Claude Code signs the commits it makes with this address, the Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com> byline its includeCoAuthoredBy setting controls (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings).
